flags.title: Partial collection, not the full OLBG event universe
flags.detail: All 15 brief categories have source checks. No category is globally complete. Returned hub cards were empty in this retrieval channel; neither live OLBG tip eligibility nor bookmaker availability has been confirmed for these official fixtures.

flags.title: Initial draft claims withdrawn
flags.detail: The first draft copied an earlier desk, changed timestamps and asserted fresh verification without actual reads. Its 81-fixture/51-High/51-prediction claims and copied prose are withdrawn. Passing structure checks did not validate those facts. Replacement data use only the retained new observations.

flags.title: No supported Medium or High tier
flags.detail: This version has no measured held-out calibration, complete current availability/form/history checks or confirmed eligible quote. All experimental prices stay Low. The five-per-sport daily High target has a shortfall of 75; no lower threshold or tuned handicap is used to fill it.

flags.title: Ningbo opponent and availability conflict
flags.detail: New official order of play pairs Fernandez with Bouzkova, not Kostyuk. Official draw notes a Kostyuk right-wrist injury. Previously copied Fernandez–Kostyuk data and prediction removed.

flags.title: Osaka pairings corrected
flags.detail: Official order of play lists Ann Li–Ashlyn Krueger and Katie Boulter–Katerina Siniakova. The older Li–Boulter matchup is not accepted.

flags.title: Polish volleyball redirect conflict
flags.detail: PlusLiga request resolved to TAURON Liga with men's team names. The competition identity conflict is retained, not silently repaired. No rows/prices imported from that response; independently read Italian SuperLega rows are separate.

flags.title: NBA collection failed/partial
flags.detail: NBA games page returned a refresh error and the public scoreboard JSON attempt failed HTTP 500. Three pairings from the official newsletter are retained as schedule text only. The other nine Friday games are unknown, not zero. No early-season strength is invented.

flags.title: Conditional MLB games withheld
flags.detail: MLB ifNecessary=Y for World Series Games 5 and 6. Scheduled is not confirmation they will be needed. Every price and selection is withheld; Game 6 is also beyond the exact rolling window.

flags.title: Regular-season MLB inputs are not playoff form
flags.detail: Run aggregates retain the 2026 regular-season period and original provider update timestamps. No probable pitcher, bullpen, park, lineup, injury or postseason adjustment has been measured. Four games sharing the same simplified price is a limitation, not four fresh independent analyses.

flags.title: Gaelic Sports scope made explicit
flags.detail: Fresh OLBG Hurling page explicitly describes Gaelic Sports as Football and Hurling. Both are grouped under the one requested category, with separate competitions. This supersedes the inherited football-only assumption; no hybrid shinty/camogie game or cross-code strength comparison is imported.

flags.title: Automatic freshness is not automatic collection
flags.detail: This desk is a selected session import. Its browser and rebuild gates withdraw estimates on expiry but do not collect new source facts. The repository's canonical scheduled collectors are separate and partial; this namespace is not falsely labelled continuously updated.

flags.title: No hidden-feed workaround
flags.detail: OLBG robots restricts /api/, /storage/app/json_data/* and Python-urllib. Only public pages and competition routes were checked through fetch_page. Empty extraction is not proof of zero matches or a proven zero-tip suppression mechanism.

flags.title: Date-only and not-before times
flags.detail: Unlabelled, Not Before and switchable display clocks never become invented exact UTC starts. Those fields remain null with source calendar dates and published text shown separately. Such entries cannot generate pre-match estimates.
